lines.say: Fourteen Nobel prizes. And most homes have no safe room.
So let's climb Israel's pyramid. From the bottom.
Water. In a desert, eighty six percent of drinking water comes from the sea.
Next, safety. Every new home since nineteen ninety three must have a safe room.
Yet fifty six percent of homes still don't have one.
Belonging? Almost three kids per woman, the most in the OECD. Friday dinner is a crowd.
Esteem? Four Eurovision wins. Very important for national security.
And at the very top: fourteen Nobel prizes.
Six point eight percent of GDP on research. No rich country spends more.
Maslow said: fix the basics, then dream. Israel dreamed first.
The result? The eighth happiest country on Earth.
Which level should Israel fix next?
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
So how does one country have this?

caption_en:
Maslow says this country should not exist. 🔺

In 1943 Abraham Maslow drew a pyramid of human needs: basics and safety first, dreams last. Climb Israel's from the bottom:

💧 Basics: about 86% of drinking water came from desalination in 2022 (Israel Water Authority data).
🛡️ Safety: a protected room (mamad) is required in every new home since a 1993 law, yet 56% of households still have none (Israel Builders Association, 2025).
💛 Belonging: 2.9 children per woman, the highest in the OECD, the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD 2024; Israel CBS: 2.88 in 2025).
🏆 Esteem: 4 Eurovision wins (1978, 1979, 1998, 2018).
🚀 Self actualisation: 14 Israeli Nobel laureates since 1948 (latest: Joel Mokyr, 2025). Research spending 6.8% of GDP, the highest in the OECD (OECD MSTI, March 2026 release, 2024 data).

The result: 8th happiest country on Earth (World Happiness Report 2026).

Big on dreams. Basics still unfinished. Which level should Israel fix next? Tell me in the comments.

caption_he:
14 זוכי נובל. ו־56% מהבתים בלי ממ"ד.
לפי הפירמידה של מאסלו (1943) מתחילים מהבסיס ורק בסוף חולמים. בואו נטפס על הפירמידה של ישראל מלמטה:
מים: 86% ממי השתייה מגיעים מהים. ביטחון: ממ"ד חובה בכל בית חדש מאז 1993, אבל 56% מהבתים עדיין בלי. שייכות: 2.9 ילדים לאישה, הכי הרבה ב־OECD. הערכה: 4 זכיות באירוויזיון. ובפסגה: 14 זוכי נובל ו־6.8% מהתוצר למחקר.
התוצאה? המדינה השמינית הכי מאושרת בעולם.
איזו קומה ישראל צריכה לתקן קודם?
